source_title: EVOTECH PERFORMANCE DUCATI MONSTER 821 FRONT FORK SPINDLE BOBBINS
description: Pre Order Import on Order only
source_description_html:
[des]

Pre Order  Import on Order only

Delivery Time 25-30 Days

[/des]

Evotech Performance have developed an innovative spindle bobbin system which allows the bobbin head to rotate on impact.

This is down to the aluminium spacer system that provides a solid core for the location of the nylon bobbin head. 

Using this system we have increased the overall durability and impact resistance of our spindle bobbin kits.

Evotech Performance front spindle bobbins are retained by roll threaded stainless steel spindles for increased strength.

Evotech Performance spindle bobbin kits comprise of two nylon bobbins, two anodised aluminium spacers, S/S spindle, nuts, washers and a hollow spindle nut when required.

Made in England from high performance engineering materials in order to protect your expensive fork bottoms and brake calipers in the event of a spill.

Evotech Performance supplies individual components should you require any replacements.

description: Evotech Performance have developed an innovative spindle bobbin system which allows the bobbin head to rotate on impact.
source_description_html:
Evotech Performance have developed an innovative spindle bobbin system which allows the bobbin head to rotate on impact.

This is down to the aluminium spacer system that provides a solid core for the location of the nylon bobbin head. 

Using this system we have increased the overall durability and impact resistance of our spindle bobbin kits.

Evotech Performance front spindle bobbins are retained by roll threaded stainless steel spindles for increased strength.

Evotech Performance spindle bobbin kits comprise of two nylon bobbins, two anodised aluminium spacers, S/S spindle, nuts, washers and a hollow spindle nut when required.

Made in England from high performance engineering materials in order to protect your expensive fork bottoms and brake calipers in the event of a spill.

Evotech Performance front spindle bobbins are retained by roll threaded stainless steel spindles for increased strength.

Made in England from high performance engineering materials in order to protect your expensive fork bottoms and brake calipers in the event of a spill.

Using this system we have increased the overall durability and impact resistance of our spindle bobbin kits.

Made in England from high performance engineering materials in order to protect your expensive fork bottoms and brake calipers in the event of a spill.

description: Evotech Performance have developed an innovative spindle bobbin system which allows the bobbin head to rotate on impact.
source_description_html:
Evotech Performance have developed an innovative spindle bobbin system which allows the bobbin head to rotate on impact.

This is down to the aluminium spacer system that provides a solid core for the location of the nylon bobbin head. 

Using this system we have increased the overall durability and impact resistance of our spindle bobbin kits.

Evotech Performance front spindle bobbins are retained by roll threaded stainless steel spindles for increased strength.

Evotech Performance spindle bobbin kits comprise of two nylon bobbins, two anodised aluminium spacers, S/S spindle, nuts, washers and a hollow spindle nut when required.

Made in England from high performance engineering materials in order to protect your expensive fork bottoms and brake calipers in the event of a spill.

Evotech headlight guards fit like original factory equipment should, using the existing mountings and requires no modification to your Triumph Tiger.

The head light guard can be removed in seconds to allow the light to be cleaned. This is down to the unique design aspect of the securing system.

Elegant in concept, the matrix is pierced with hexagonal holes to providing maximum protection from road debris.

description: What is Spindle Bobbin Crash Protection? • Spindle Bobbin positioned on the driveline side. • Guards the costly swing arm and sprocket carriers. • Bobbin made from hard-wearing nylon with an aluminium base. • Held through the rear wheel by a stainless steel spindle rod.
source_description_html:
• Spindle Bobbin positioned on the driveline side
  • Guards the costly swing arm and sprocket carriers
  • Bobbin made from hard-wearing nylon with an aluminium base
  • Held through the rear wheel by a stainless steel spindle rod
  • Red-anodised hub stop on exhaust side
  • Replacement bobbin heads are available to purchase
 
What is Spindle Bobbin Crash Protection?

Designed to protect the driveline side of the RSV4 RF, the spindle head juts from the rear wheel hoping to take impact before the swing arm.  The inventive design allows the nylon bobbin to spin above the aluminium core which brings greater durability and eases stress on the wheel. The bobbin is held through the wheel using a spindle rod with an attractive red hub stop on the exhaust side.

What protection does an EP motorcycle radiator & header guard set give?

An EP radiator guard protects the Kawasaki Ninja ZX-10R radiator from damage while allowing cooling air to pass through - and look good at the same time. A radiator's delicate cooling fins easily bend, and misaligned fins can cause overheating. The radiator's internal cores can also be holed by stones, etc; all usually picked up and flung directly into the radiator from the bike's front tyre or from other traffic. Leaking coolant will make the motorbike inoperable because of overheating, which can result in engine damage.

Features of EP Radiator Guard Set for Triumph Bonneville T120
  • Constructed from aerospace quality aluminium for lightness and rigidity
  • Designed to provide maximum protection from stones and other road debris
  • EP hexagonal matrix hole-pattern maintains airflow for required cooling
  • EP products are fabricated to ensure a secure, precise fit and easy installation
  • Finished coating on the guard and guard shroud is durable black powder coat
  • All fasteners and fixtures included

What is the reason for fitting an EP Radiator Guard?
The EP Radiator Guard protects the Triumph Bonneville T120 radiator from damage by road debris, while at the same time allowing all-important cooling air to pass through. The radiator cooling fins easily bend from flung debris and can restrict cooling air, which could lead to overheating. Also, the radiator's internal aluminium core can be holed by large or small stones. A seriously damaged radiator can leak coolant to make the motorcycle inoperable through overheating and can lead to engine damage. Replacing a split radiator is very expensive compared to the purchase price of an EP Radiator Guard.

Features of Evotech Radiator Guard for Honda CB1000 Hornet
  • Light-weight aluminium construction fabricated for precise fit and easy installation
  • All EP radiator guards are designed to give uninterrupted airflow
  • EP hexagonal matrix hole-pattern provides a rigid defence against stones and other debris
  • Durable black powder coated finish with EP Brand Logo
  • Direct bolt-on fitment with no modifications required
  • Comes complete with required fixtures
  • Fitting instructions available to download

 

Why is a motorcycle radiator guard necessary?

The Evotech radiator guard helps protect the Honda CB1000 Hornet radiator from road debris damage; damage that occurs when stones are picked up and thrown by the front tyre or other traffic. The radiator is predominantly made up of delicate cooling fins that easily bend; within the cooler there is an internal core of pipework that can be damaged beyond safe repair. Misaligned cooling fins block passing air and this can lead to the engine overheating. Holed coolant carrying galleries cause rapid overheating with a high possibility of engine damage. Leaking coolant can also cause loss of grip if it reaches the motorcycle's tyres.

description: Features of EP Radiator Guard for Triumph Daytona 660 • Precision-made all-aluminium construction designed for easy and exact fitment. • EP Radiator Guard provides maximum defence against road debris. • Hexagonal matrix hole-pattern allows full flow of cooling air. • Designed for high strength to weight ratio.
source_description_html:
Features of EP Radiator Guard for Triumph Daytona 660
  • Precision-made all-aluminium construction designed for easy and exact fitment
  • EP Radiator Guard provides maximum defence against road debris
  • Hexagonal matrix hole-pattern allows full flow of cooling air
  • Designed for high strength to weight ratio
  • No additional chassis modifications required
  • Durable black powder coated finish
  • Anti-vibration pads included
  • Fitting instructions available to download

 

Why fit an EP Radiator Guard?

Radiators are designed to cool engine coolant and are positioned to catch passing airflow to achieve this. Because of their position they are at risk to being damaged by road debris. The Daytona 660 Radiator Guard is designed to protect the radiator's delicate cooling fins and internal waterways by preventing stones and other debris from 'shot blasting' or, worse, puncturing the radiator's delicate aluminium construction to cause it to leak. The result of which will be overheating, which, in turn, can result in engine damage. Escaping coolant can also leak onto the tyres and cause sudden loss of grip.

The Ducati Streetfighter’s naked design means the engine sump is prone to being hit by road surface debris. description: Features of EP Oil Cooler Guard for Triumph Speed Triple • Lightweight graded aluminium construction with EP hexagonal matrix hole-pattern. • Designed to give a secure, precise fit with easy installation. • Formed to align with the lines of the oil cooler. • Designed to give unrestricted airflow for efficient cooling.
source_description_html:
Features of EP Oil Cooler Guard for Triumph Speed Triple
  • Lightweight graded aluminium construction with EP hexagonal matrix hole-pattern
  • Designed to give a secure, precise fit with easy installation
  • Formed to align with the lines of the oil cooler
  • Designed to give unrestricted airflow for efficient cooling
  • No additional modifications are required to the chassis or bodywork
  • Black powder coat gives a factory-like durable finish
  • Fitting instructions available to download
Why fit an EP Oil Cooler Guard?

Oil coolers are designed and positioned to catch passing airflow, which cools engine oil pumped through the cooler's internal core. Unfortunately, its positioning places the cooler so it is 'open' to damage from road debris. The Triumph Speed Triple EP Oil Cooler Guard is designed to protect the cooler's delicate cooling fins and core by preventing stones, grit and other road debris from bending the cooling fins or, worse, puncturing the delicate aluminium core causing it to leak. The result of which will be overheating and low oil pressure, which, in turn, can result in engine damage.

Why buy an Evotech Performance Tail Tidy?

An Evotech Tail Tidy is a stylish, quality aftermarket replacement for the OE rear fender and rear lighting system, which gives a motorcycle a sportier look. In most cases, an Evotech Tail Tidy repositions the bike’s number / license plate and lighting systems to a higher or tucked-in position to deliver a sharper, more race bike like silhouette on sports bikes, or lessen the bulkiness of, say, an adventure-styled motorcycle. Wherever possible, an Evotech Tail Tidy will include design details to further enhance the motorcycle’s aesthetics by complementing the bike’s profile, for example an Evotech replacement, EC-approved rear light system. Ease of fitment is standard for our tail tidies – precision engineering and quality materials go some way to ensure this. Plug & play is used to describe the simple reconnection of any wiring systems when fitting an Evotech Tail Tidy or if Evotech replacement lighting systems are included, Evotech Performance supplies electrical components with like-for-like connectors or wiring terminals for a straightforward, easy connection.

source_title: Evotech Performance Radiator Guard for Suzuki GSX-S1000 2015-21
description: Features of EP Radiator Guard for Suzuki GSX-S1000 • Light-weight, all-aluminium construction and fabricated for precise fit and easy installation. • A hexagonal matrix hole-pattern provides a strong, rigid defence against road debris. • EP radiator guards are formed to closely follow the curvature of the radiator. • Delivers maximum airflow for all-important radiator cooling.
source_description_html:
Features of EP Radiator Guard for Suzuki GSX-S1000

  • Light-weight, all-aluminium construction and fabricated for precise fit and easy installation
  • A hexagonal matrix hole-pattern provides a strong, rigid defence against road debris
  • EP radiator guards are formed to closely follow the curvature of the radiator
  • Delivers maximum airflow for all-important radiator cooling
  • Black powder coat finish
  • Requires no modifications to existing chassis components
  • Anti-vibration material included
  • Fitting instructions available to download

 

Is an EP radiator guard really necessary?

Most definitely. An EP radiator guard protects the Suzuki GSX-S1000 radiator from damage caused by road debris, while allowing cooling air to pass through. The Suzuki radiator consists of delicate cooling fins and internal cores - these fins easily bend and block the passage of air, which can lead to the engine overheating. Also, the internal cores can be holed by debris, such as a stone. This is usually the result of debris being picked up by the bike's front tyre and flung directly into the radiator. Not only will this lead to engine overheating but slippery coolant on tyres can cause loss of grip.

description: Features of EP Rectifier Guard for Triumph Speed Triple 1200 RS • Precision-made all-aluminium construction. • Designed to be fitted to existing chassis mounting points. • No modifications required to chassis components. • EP Rectifier Guard provides maximum defence against road debris.
source_description_html:
Features of EP Rectifier Guard for Triumph Speed Triple 1200 RS
  • Precision-made all-aluminium construction
  • Designed to be fitted to existing chassis mounting points
  • No modifications required to chassis components
  • EP Rectifier Guard provides maximum defence against road debris
  • Hexagonal matrix hole-pattern gives maximum defence against road debris
  • Does not restrict passage of airflow
  • Durable black powder coated finish
  • Fixtures where required are included
  • Fitting instructions available to download

 

Why fit an EP Rectifier Guard?

A motorcycle rectifier converts generated AC electrical current to DC current and supplies a regulated DC voltage to the battery. This means the rectifier generates heat and is positioned to enable open or passing air to cool it. Unfortunately, the rectifier's positioning means it is vulnerable to being damaged by road debris (stones, grit etc). The EP Rectifier Guard protects the rectifier from stones, while maintaining airflow to prevent the rectifier from overheating. Let's not forget the EP Rectifier Guard is designed to be stylish as well as functional and enhances the Triumph Street Twin's retro looks.

Features of EP Radiator Guard for Triumph Trident
  • Precision-made all-aluminium radiator guard with high strength to weight ratio
  • Designed to be easily fitted by the owner
  • Hexagonal matrix hole-pattern is a perfect defence against stones without restricting airflow
  • The EP guard is formed to follow exactly the lines of the radiator
  • The guard uses existing mounting points with no additional modifications required
  • Durable black powder coated finish
  • Anti-vibration pads are included

Why would a Triumph Trident require a radiator guard?
EP radiator guards are designed to protect a motorcycle radiator from damage caused by road debris, while allowing essential cooling air to pass through. Regardless of engine capacity and overall performance, without a quality radiator guard in place the radiator cooling fins can get hammered and stone chippings, flung from the front tyre or passing traffic, can hole the radiator core. As a fragile and intricate component, the Trident radiator is very difficult to repair (in most cases beyond economical repair) and expensive to replace.

description: Features of EP Rear Spindle Bobbins for BMW R 1250 GS Adventure • Unique design by Evotech Performance. • Cassette-style mounting firmly secures the rear wheel protective bobbin. • Nylon bobbin with powder-coated aluminium hub stop. • Cassette mount incorporates O-rings to prevent ingress of water to the wheel hub.
source_description_html:
Features of EP Rear Spindle Bobbins for BMW R 1250 GS Adventure  
  • Unique design by Evotech Performance
  • Cassette-style mounting firmly secures the rear wheel protective bobbin
  • Nylon bobbin with powder-coated aluminium hub stop
  • Cassette mount incorporates O-rings to prevent ingress of water to the wheel hub
  • Simple and quick to install: grease, insert and tighten
  • Replacement nylon bobbin are available to purchase separately

 

What is Spindle Bobbin Crash Protection?

What protection do the EP motorcycle radiator guards give?
The two EP Radiator Guards protect the BMW R 1250 GS Adventure radiators from damage by road debris while allowing cooling air to pass through. A radiator’s delicate cooling fins easily bend, and misaligned fins can cause overheating. The radiators’ internal cores can also be punctured by stones, which are usually picked up and flung directly into the radiator from passing traffic or other vehicles in front. Leaking coolant will make the R 1250 GS Adventure inoperable because of overheating, which can result in engine damage. Leaking coolant is also slippery and can cause loss of grip if it gets onto the tyres.

source_description_html:
Key Features of EP Rear Spindle Bobbins for the Ducati Monster 950
  • Injection-moulded nylon bobbin head fixed either side of the rear wheel
  • Aluminium core for each bobbin provides extra strength
  • Replacement nylon bobbin heads available to purchase  separately
  • Made from engineering quality materials by Evotech Performance
  • Easy to install through the rear wheel spindle

 

What is Spindle Bobbin Crash Protection?

EP Rear Spindle Bobbins for the Ducati Monster 950 are designed to guard the rear wheel lower swing arm, sprocket carriers and brake calipers. As they protrude from either side of the wheel, the bobbin heads are expected to take impact first in an incident with the dual materials offering durability and strength. Furthermore, the nylon bobbin heads are free to turn above the aluminium inner to reduce stress on the wheel.

Protecting the front wheel lower forks and brake calipers, EP Front Spindle Bobbins for the Ninja ZX-10R stand out from the wheel, hoping to be first to receive impact in an incident.   Manufactured from hard-wearing nylon and aluminium, the innovative design allows the nylon outer to rotate on contact to reduce stress on the wheel.   Both bobbin heads are secured in place by a stainless steel spindle rod.

description: Features of EP Radiator & Oil Cooler guard set for the Kawasaki Ninja ZX-10R • All-aluminium light-weight construction engineered for easy, precise fit. • Hexagonal matrix hole-pattern ensures strong defence from stone damage. • EP Radiator & Oil Cooler guard set is formed to follow the lines of the Aprilia radiator. • Designed to deliver maximum airflow for all-important radiator cooling.
source_description_html:
Features of EP Radiator & Oil Cooler guard set for the Kawasaki Ninja ZX-10R

  • All-aluminium light-weight construction engineered for easy, precise fit
  • Hexagonal matrix hole-pattern ensures strong defence from stone damage
  • EP Radiator & Oil Cooler guard set is formed to follow the lines of the Aprilia radiator
  • Designed to deliver maximum airflow for all-important radiator cooling
  • Durable black powder coated finish
  • All fasteners and anti-vibration material included
  • Fitting instructions available to download

What protection does an EP motorcycle radiator & header guard set give?

An EP radiator guard protects the Kawasaki Ninja ZX-10R radiator from damage while allowing cooling air to pass through - and look good at the same time. A radiator's delicate cooling fins easily bend, and misaligned fins can cause overheating. The radiator's internal cores can also be holed by stones, etc; all usually picked up and flung directly into the radiator from the bike's front tyre or from other traffic. Leaking coolant will make the motorbike inoperable because of overheating, which can result in engine damage.

source_description_html:
Features of EP Radiator Guard for Triumph Speed Triple RS
  • Fabricated from aerospace quality aluminium
  • Pre-curved to match the curvature of the standard radiator
  • Engineered to provide maximum protection from stones and other road debris
  • EP hexagonal matrix hole-pattern gives unrestricted airflow for efficient cooling
  • Designed to give a secure, precise fit with easy installation process
  • Black powder coat gives a durable factory-like finish
  • All fixtures and fittings where required are supplied
  • Fitting instructions available to download 
How does an EP Radiator Guard help me?
Simply put, an EP Radiator Guard protects the Triumph Speed Triple RS radiator from damage caused by road debris (stones, mud, dropped waste etc), while at the same time allowing cool air to pass through. The radiator's thin, soft aluminium cooling fins easily bend, and misaligned fins can restrict cooling air, which can lead to overheating. The radiator's internal core is also susceptible to being holed by stones that can be picked up by the front tyre or other traffic and flung directly into the radiator. Leaking coolant will make the Triumph Speed Triple RS overheat, which, in turn, can lead to engine damage.

description: Features of EP Radiator Guard for Suzuki GSX1300R • Fabricated from aerospace quality aluminium. • Engineered to provide maximum protection from stones and other road debris. • EP hexagonal matrix hole-pattern gives unrestricted airflow for efficient cooling. • Designed to give a secure, precise fit with easy installation process.
source_description_html:
Features of EP Radiator Guard for Suzuki GSX1300R

  • Fabricated from aerospace quality aluminium
  • Engineered to provide maximum protection from stones and other road debris
  • EP hexagonal matrix hole-pattern gives unrestricted airflow for efficient cooling
  • Designed to give a secure, precise fit with easy installation process
  • Black powder coat gives a durable factory-like finish
  • Damper pads included
  • Fitting instructions available to download

 

What does an EP Radiator Guard deliver?

The EP radiator guard protects the Suzuki GSX1300R radiator from damage caused by road debris (stones, mud, dropped waste etc) while at the same time allowing cool air to pass through. The radiator's thin, soft aluminium cooling fins easily bend, and bent fins can restrict cooling air, which can lead to overheating. The radiator's internal cores are also prone to being holed by stones that can be picked up by the front tyre and flung directly into the radiator. Leaking coolant can make the GSX1300R inoperable because of overheating, which, in turn, can quickly lead to engine damage.

How does an EP Radiator Guard help me?

Simply put, an Evotech Radiator Guard protects the Triumph Street Triple 765 R radiator from damage caused by road debris (stones, mud, dropped waste etc), while at the same time allowing cool air to pass through. The radiator's thin, soft aluminium cooling fins easily bend, and misaligned fins can restrict cooling air, which can lead to overheating. The radiator's internal core is also susceptible to being holed by stones that can be picked up by the front tyre or other traffic and flung directly into the radiator. Leaking coolant will make the Triumph Street Triple 765 R overheat, which, in turn, can lead to engine damage.

Leaking coolant will make the Triumph Street Triple 765 R overheat, which, in turn, can lead to engine damage.

description: Features of EP Radiator Guard Set for Triumph Speed 400 • Constructed from aerospace quality aluminium for lightness and rigidity. • Designed to provide maximum protection from stones and other road debris. • EP hexagonal matrix hole-pattern maintains airflow for required cooling. • EP products are fabricated to ensure a secure, precise fit and easy installation.
source_description_html:
Features of EP Radiator Guard Set for Triumph Speed 400
  • Constructed from aerospace quality aluminium for lightness and rigidity
  • Designed to provide maximum protection from stones and other road debris
  • EP hexagonal matrix hole-pattern maintains airflow for required cooling
  • EP products are fabricated to ensure a secure, precise fit and easy installation
  • Finished coating on the guard is durable black powder coat
  • All fasteners and fixtures included
  • Fitting instructions available to download

What is the reason for fitting an EP Radiator Guard?

The EP Radiator Guard protects the Triumph Speed 400 radiator from damage by road debris, while at the same time allowing all-important cooling air to pass through. The radiator cooling fins easily bend from flung debris and can restrict cooling air, which could lead to overheating. Also, the radiator's internal aluminium core can be holed by large or small stones. A seriously damaged radiator can leak coolant to make the motorcycle inoperable through overheating and can lead to engine damage. Replacing a split radiator is very expensive compared to the purchase price of an EP Radiator Guard.

  • Light-weight, all-aluminium construction fabricated for precise fit and easy installation
  • The EP hexagonal matrix hole-pattern provides a strong, rigid defence against road debris

Is an EP radiator guard really necessary?

100% yes. An EP radiator guard protects the GSX-8R  radiator from light and severe damage caused by road debris, while allowing cooling air to pass through. The Suzuki radiator consists of thin cooling fins and internal cores - the fins easily bend and block the passage of air, which will eventually lead to overheating and reduction in engine performance. The internal cores could also be holed by debris, such as a stone being picked up by the bike's front tyre or other traffic and flung directly at the radiator. The result is rapid engine overheating, and if the slippery coolant sprays onto the tyres it can cause sudden loss of grip.

Will these fit my bike and can I fit them myself?

Features of Evotech Evo Folding Clutch & Brake Lever Set for the Suzuki GSX-8R
  • Designed by Evotech Performance using state of the art design software – and riding experience
  • Anatomically correct deep radiused edges along each lever length for comfort, feel and style
  • Lever blades pivot upwards upon contact with a solid object to help prevent breakage –manually returns to original position

  • Six-position adjustment span via an anodised adjuster on both levers to suit varying finger lengths

  • Durable black anodise finish on lever blades and bracket mount unions

  • Video fitting instructions available for download

 

What is an EP Evo Folding Clutch & Brake Lever Set?

Quite simply, a quality, British-designed, full length aftermarket clutch and brake lever set that are fully adjustable, stylish and are less prone to break in the event of spill, or simple drop of the bike to enable you to carry on riding. Each EP Evo Folding Clutch & Brake Lever features a pivot point that allows the lever to move upwards when it is struck by a solid object. The pivot point features a tensioned spring system to hold the lever in place as per a standard lever, so it cannot accidentally be moved by the rider’s hands/fingers. EP brake levers and EP clutch levers also feature a six-way finger span adjuster to fine tune the ideal lever position.

 

Are they for road or track day use, and are they safe to be used on the road?

All EP Evo Folding Clutch & Brake Lever Sets are designed for road, track day and even off-road excursions on ADV bikes – basically any riding situation you would normally ride your road-going motorcycle. With regards to them being safe to use – they are very safe. Each component part has been designed by Evotech Performance engineers to deal with the rigours of an OE clutch and brake lever with added benefit of a pivot system to allow both levers to pivot upwards when they hit a solid object. This reduces the chances of the levers breaking and leaving you stranded.

description: Features of EP Radiator Guard for Triumph Street Triple S • Precision-made all-aluminium radiator guard designed for easy and exact fit. • Hexagonal matrix hole-pattern is a tough defence against road debris. • Formed to follow exactly the lines of the radiator and allows maximum airflow. • The guard uses existing mounting points with no additional modifications required.

Features of EP Radiator Guard for Triumph Street Triple S
  • Precision-made all-aluminium radiator guard designed for easy and exact fit
  • Hexagonal matrix hole-pattern is a tough defence against road debris
  • Formed to follow exactly the lines of the radiator and allows maximum airflow
  • The guard uses existing mounting points with no additional modifications required

Why does a Triumph Street Triple S require a radiator guard?

EP radiator guards are designed to protect the motorcycle radiator from damage caused by road debris (stones, broken roadside furniture etc) but allow essential cooling air to pass through. Regardless of the engine capacity and overall performance, without a quality radiator guard in place the radiator, especially the cooling fins, can get trashed by road debris. There is also a high risk of road chippings holing the coolant-carrying pipework within the radiator core. As a fragile and intricate component, the Triumph Street Triple S aluminium radiator is very difficult to repair (in most cases beyond economical repair) and expensive to replace. There is also added worry of the engine overheating severely enough to cause mechanical damage.

Features of Evotech Evo Short Clutch & Brake Lever Set for the Kawasaki Ninja ZX-4R
  • Designed by Evotech Performance using state of the art design software – and riding experience
  • Anatomically correct deep radiused edges along each lever length for comfort, feel and style
  • EP EVO lever blades are shorter than the OE equivalents and commonly referred to as “two-finger levers”
  • Usable lever width is 55mm approx. to easily accommodate two gloved fingers
  • The “short-length” style reduces the chances of contact with a solid object and breaking
  • Safeguard “snap point” positioned at lever ball end
  • Six-position adjustment span to suit varying finger lengths on both levers via an anodised adjuster
  • Lever adjustment position shown via machined indents
  • 17mm typical (+/- 1mm) lever span adjustment range (measured at lever midpoint)
  • Lever blade and bracket mount union machined from billet aluminium
  • Stainless steel CNC-machined clevis pins and retaining clips and, where supplied, piston adjustment screw/barrel and tension retaining spring
  • Scalloped machining on lever rear reduces weight while retaining strength
  • CNC-machined bracket mount unions ensure a precise and fuss-free install of OE components
  • Lever ball-end dimensions meet statutory requirements
  • Durable black anodise finish on lever blades and bracket mount unions
  • Red durable anodise finish on span adjusters
  • Alternative colour (green, silver, blue, black, gold, orange, titanium) span adjusters available from our EP Accessories section
  • Levers and bracket mount unions feature Evotech Performance brand logos
  • Video fitting instructions available for download

 

Will these fit my bike and can I fit them myself?

Every EP Evo Short Clutch & Brake Lever Set is manufactured for a specific model i.e. they are not universal due to each make/model having different mountings, clutch cut-out and brake light switches etc. EP Evo Short Clutch & Brake Lever Sets are currently available for 110+ models with more being added daily – so yes, there’s every chance we can supply an EP Evo Short Clutch & Brake Lever Set for your bike. A basic toolkit is all that’s required to replace the OE levers with an EP Evo Short Clutch & Brake Lever Set. Used in conjunction with the Evotech Performance downloadable video instructions, fitting is straightforward.

 

Why don’t we see shorty levers on a standard motorcycle?

Motorcycles are mass produced and must accommodate all shapes and sizes of owner, rider experience and more. So, the easy way to accommodate these variables is to produce levers that will suit all. An EP Evo Short Clutch & Brake Lever Set has inbuilt adjustment to tailor lever span for a rider’s hand size/finger reach. The fact the EP brake levers and EP clutch levers are shorter than OE is to minimise the risk of them hitting and breaking on a solid object e.g. road surface. Also, using just two fingers to apply braking force means the remainder of your fingers remain on the handlebar and, therefore, better control of the motorcycle steering system.

Features of Evotech Evo Folding Clutch & Brake Lever Set for the Kawasaki ZX-4R 
  • Designed by Evotech Performance using state of the art design software – and riding experience
  • Anatomically correct deep radiused edges along each lever length for comfort, feel and style
  • Lever blades pivot upwards upon contact with a solid object to help prevent breakage –manually returns to original position
  • Lever held firmly in place by tensioned spring and bearing and cannot accidentally be moved out of position
  • Six-position adjustment span via an anodised adjuster on both levers to suit varying finger lengths
  • Adjustment position shown via machined indents

  • Lever ball-end dimensions meet statutory requirements
  • Durable black anodise finish on lever blades and bracket mount unions
  • Red durable anodise finish on span adjusters
  • Alternative colour (green, silver, blue, black, gold, orange, titanium) span adjusters available from our EP Accessories section
  • Levers and bracket mount unions feature Evotech Performance brand logos
  • Video fitting instructions available for download

 

What is an EP Evo Folding Clutch & Brake Lever Set?

Quite simply, a quality, British-designed, full length aftermarket clutch and brake lever set that are fully adjustable, stylish and are less prone to break in the event of spill, or simple drop of the bike to enable you to carry on riding. Each EP Evo Folding Clutch & Brake Lever features a pivot point that allows the lever to move upwards when it is struck by a solid object. The pivot point features a tensioned spring system to hold the lever in place as per a standard lever, so it cannot accidentally be moved by the rider’s hands/fingers. EP brake levers and EP clutch levers also feature a six-way finger span adjuster to fine tune the ideal lever position.

 

Are they for road or track day use, and are they safe to be used on the road?

All EP Evo Folding Clutch & Brake Lever Sets are designed for road, track day and even off-road excursions on ADV bikes – basically any riding situation you would normally ride your road-going motorcycle. With regards to them being safe to use – they are very safe. Each component part has been designed by Evotech Performance engineers to deal with the rigours of an OE clutch and brake lever with added benefit of a pivot system to allow both levers to pivot upwards when they hit a solid object. This reduces the chances of the levers breaking and leaving you stranded.

description: Features of EP Rear Spindle Bobbins for the Ducati Diavel V4 • Developed to protect the driveline side of your Ducati's rear wheel. • Spindle Bobbin of matt black injection-moulded nylon covering an aluminium spacer. • Positioned through the wheel by a rolled-thread spindle rod. • Anodised red hub stop ends the exhaust side of the spindle rod.
source_description_html:
Features of EP Rear Spindle Bobbins for the Ducati Diavel V4
  • Developed to protect the driveline side of your Ducati's rear wheel
  • Spindle Bobbin of matt black injection-moulded nylon covering an aluminium spacer
  • Positioned through the wheel by a rolled-thread spindle rod
  • Anodised red hub stop ends the exhaust side of the spindle rod
  • Replacement bobbin heads are available for purchase separately

 

What is Spindle Bobbin Crash Protection?

Covering the driveline side of the rear wheel, EP Rear Spindle Bobbins for the Ducati Diavel V4 offer extra protection for the lower single swing arm and sprocket carriers.   The protruding spindle bobbin, machined from durable injection-moulded nylon and supported by a strong aluminium inner, offers a first defence should an incident occur. The innovative EP design allows the nylon to rotate on impact to reduce stress on the wheel.   On the exhaust side, a striking red-anodised hub stop finishes the spindle rod.

source_description_html:
Features of Evotech Evo Folding Clutch & Brake Lever Set for the Ducati Diavel V4 
  • Designed by Evotech Performance using state of the art design software – and riding experience
  • Anatomically correct deep radiused edges along each lever length for comfort, feel and style
  • Lever blades pivot upwards upon contact with a solid object to help prevent breakage –manually returns to original position
  • Lever held firmly in place by tensioned spring and bearing and cannot accidentally be moved out of position
  • Six-position adjustment span via an anodised adjuster on both levers to suit varying finger lengths
  • Adjustment position shown via machined indents
  • 17mm typical (+/- 1mm) lever span adjustment range (measured at lever midpoint)
  • Lever blade and bracket mount union machined from billet aluminium
  • Stainless steel CNC-machined clevis pins, retaining clips and, where supplied, piston adjustment screw/barrel and tension retaining spring
  • Scalloped machining to rear of lever reduces weight while retaining strength
  • CNC-machined bracket mount unions for a precise and fuss-free install of OE components
  • Lever ball-end dimensions meet statutory requirements
  • Durable black anodise finish on lever blades and bracket mount unions
  • Red durable anodise finish on span adjusters
  • Alternative colour (green, silver, blue, black, gold, orange, titanium) span adjusters available from our EP Accessories section
  • Levers and bracket mount unions feature Evotech Performance brand logos
  • Video fitting instructions available for download

 

What is an EP Evo Folding Clutch & Brake Lever Set?

Quite simply, a quality, British-designed, full length aftermarket clutch and brake lever set that are fully adjustable, stylish and are less prone to break in the event of spill, or simple drop of the bike to enable you to carry on riding. Each EP Evo Folding Clutch & Brake Lever features a pivot point that allows the lever to move upwards when it is struck by a solid object. The pivot point features a tensioned spring system to hold the lever in place as per a standard lever, so it cannot accidentally be moved by the rider’s hands/fingers. EP brake levers and EP clutch levers also feature a six-way finger span adjuster to fine tune the ideal lever position.

  • Designed by Evotech Performance using state of the art design software – and riding experience
  • Anatomically correct deep radiused edges along each lever length for comfort, feel and style
  • EP EVO lever blades are shorter than the OE equivalents and commonly referred to as “two-finger levers”
  • Usable lever width is 55mm approx. to easily accommodate two gloved fingers
  • The “short-length” style reduces the chances of contact with a solid object and breaking
  • Safeguard “snap point” positioned at lever ball end
  • Six-position adjustment span to suit varying finger lengths on both levers via an anodised adjuster
  • Lever adjustment position shown via machined indents
  • 17mm typical (+/- 1mm) lever span adjustment range (measured at lever midpoint)

  • Scalloped machining on lever rear reduces weight while retaining strength
  • CNC-machined bracket mount unions ensure a precise and fuss-free install of OE components
  • Lever ball-end dimensions meet statutory requirements
  • Durable black anodise finish on lever blades and bracket mount unions
  • Red durable anodise finish on span adjusters
  • Alternative colour (green, silver, blue, black, gold, orange, titanium) span adjusters available from our EP Accessories section
  • Levers and bracket mount unions feature Evotech Performance brand logos
  • Video fitting instructions available for download

 

Will these fit my bike and can I fit them myself?

Every EP Evo Short Clutch & Brake Lever Set is manufactured for a specific model i.e. they are not universal due to each make/model having different mountings, clutch cut-out and brake light switches etc. EP Evo Short Clutch & Brake Lever Sets are currently available for 110+ models with more being added daily – so yes, there’s every chance we can supply an EP Evo Short Clutch & Brake Lever Set for your bike. A basic toolkit is all that’s required to replace the OE levers with an EP Evo Short Clutch & Brake Lever Set. Used in conjunction with the Evotech Performance downloadable video instructions, fitting is straightforward.

Features of EP Front Spindle Bobbins for the BMW R 1300 GS Option 719 Tramuntana
  • Reliable crash protection from injection-moulded nylon bobbins sitting either side of the front wheel
  • Reinforced by an aluminium core
  • Held via a rolled-thread stainless steel through rod
  • Replacement hollow spindle bolt supplied with the kit
  • Replacement nylon bobbin heads available to purchase separately

 

What is Spindle Bobbin Crash Protection?

Designed to protect the front wheel spindle and lower forks, EP Front Spindle Bobbins for the BMW R 1300 GS Option 719 Tramuntana are a discreet addition to the front end.   Injection-moulded from matt black nylon, the bobbins are reinforced by an aluminium inner.   As the two materials are independent, the nylon slider is able to rotate with impact grab to reduce stress on the wheel and wear on the part.   To assist with installation, a replacement bolt machined with access for the spindle rod to fit through is provided.

description: Features of Evotech Radiator for the Aprilia RS 457 • All-aluminium light-weight construction engineered for easy, precise fit. • Hexagonal matrix hole-pattern ensures strong defence from stone damage. • EP Radiator guard is formed to follow the lines of the Aprilia radiator. • Designed to deliver maximum airflow for all-important radiator cooling.
source_description_html:
Features of Evotech Radiator for the Aprilia RS 457
  • All-aluminium light-weight construction engineered for easy, precise fit
  • Hexagonal matrix hole-pattern ensures strong defence from stone damage
  • EP Radiator guard is formed to follow the lines of the Aprilia radiator
  • Designed to deliver maximum airflow for all-important radiator cooling
  • Durable black powder coated finish
  • All fasteners and anti-vibration material included
  • Fitting video instructions available to download

What protection does an Evotech motorcycle radiator guard give?

An Evotech Radiator Guard protects the Aprilia RS 457 radiator from damage while allowing cooling air to pass through, plus it looks good at the same time. A radiator's delicate cooling fins easily bend, and misaligned fins can cause overheating. The radiator's internal cores can also be holed by stones, etc; all usually picked up and flung directly into the radiator from the bike's front tyre or from other traffic. Leaking coolant will make the motorbike inoperable because of overheating, which can result in engine damage.
